feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 October 2026 5:47am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 24 October 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales or severe gales.


##Synopsis##

Atlantic low (Storm Boelo) will become a very deep feature as it tracks northeastwards to the west of Scotland today.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, backing and increasing South 7 or gale 8 through this morning and early afternoon, occasionally severe gale 9 in west of area, then veering West or Southwest 7 or gale 8 late afternoon or early evening. Increasing gale 8 or severe gale 9 late evening and tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building rough or very rough.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain for a time, clearing later today.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, decreasing 7 or gale 8 tomorrow afternoon, 6 or 7 in evening, then South or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate or rough tomorrow evening, moderate overnight into Monday.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
